ctx.x: So what -- for instance, what did you learn -- what was the main thing you learned from hearing Louie Armstrong?
The things I learned from Louie Arm-

strong are the things that I heard during discussions that Louis Armstrong had with other musicians at times. I wasn't in on it, but I was standing back listening. They'd always -- try to tell a story with your horn. Whatever you play, try to make a story out of it. Don't just go up there and blow something, you know, that you'd -- you don't know what you're doing, making a lot of noise. Say, always try to tell a little story on each thing that you play. That has always stuck by me, right until today. He said,…
